extracted.name: Quick Enchilada Sauce
extracted.description: Just mix tomato sauce, tomato paste, and some spices together for a quick and very easy enchilada sauce you can whip up at a moment's notice.
ingredient_lines: 2 teaspoons chili powder, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Mix tomato sauce, tomato paste, beef broth, salt, oregano, cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, and chili powder together in a saucepan until smooth.
Bring sauce to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 10 minutes.
